science: Full stated Frank density reduces to K|grad n|^2/2. The source solves the exact fixed-trace director but drops the divergence contribution to boundary virtual work. Independent Cartesian div/curl Ritz minimization and energy differentiation validate the BVP oracle and separately the source bulk-only model. Prepared smooth branch locally stable against arbitrary fixed-trace perturbations; no claim of global uniqueness.
public_input_review: Coefficient convention, boundary director and local rotation sign, prepared branch, supplied distributed work per outer area, units, parameter and geometry domains explicit. No correction formula or solver restriction; exact neutral instruction and None unknown. Only public README/starter/tests/calibration enter image.
calibration_review: 144 flat-cell readings,24distinct settings; response linear in K, unique positive weighted fit, fixed noise sigma.003 independent of true signal. Source and oracle identical on calibration.
grading_review: Private groups obey public domain; predictions alone graded with.04 group NRMS,parameter.03,chi2<1.5. All256noisy oracle runs and both fits pass; all shortcut curved predictions fail. Source .612-.831,independent reference error<5e-7,localoracle7/7 versus4+3.
classification_caveat: Retaining bulk-only boundary work is a physical modeling error; attempted complete-energy variation with incorrect algebra,sign,units or solvers is classified separately.
